steps.draft:
Title: Akshara — offline OCR for Kannada government records

Problem: District offices hold decades of handwritten Kannada records that can't be searched.

Approach: A lightweight on-device OCR model fine-tuned on 40k labelled Kannada glyphs, with a review UI for clerks.

Impact: Makes 1.2M+ pages searchable without cloud upload, keeping citizen data on-premise.

steps.detail: The pre-submission referee flagged nothing. Approve to submit on the SIH portal before the internal round closes Oct 9.
